abstention_rate.why: the reader never abstains; every labelled page read is a page answered

canonical_mapping_exact.why: no canonical mapping is emitted; the semantics tier was not run (#737)

cell_f1.why: the reader's cells are text boxes, the gold's are cell rectangles, and the gold labels a sample of each table's cells; every unlabelled reader cell counts as a false positive

cell_span_exact.why: over matched cells only: the reader's row and column spans

cell_state_exact.why: the reader has no state tier; every cell carries the contract's default `confirmed`

cell_text_exact.why: over matched cells only: the reader's text as read against the label; vacuous when no cell matches

cell_topology_exact.why: over matched cells only, and only through matched rows and columns

column_f1.why: columns are bounding boxes of the reader's cell text boxes, not ruled bands

failure_rate.why: documents the isolated reader process failed on

header_relationships_exact.why: the reader names no header cells; the semantics tier was not run (#737)

latency.why: wall time of the isolated reader process per document, spawn included

memory.why: peak resident set of the isolated reader process per document

page_class_accuracy.why: the frozen reader has no page classifier; every page is `unclassified` (#734 owns inventory and routing)

page_coverage.why: the adapter reads every page the gold labels; coverage measures that the reader returned each

page_scoped_values.why: no page-scoped value is emitted; the semantics tier was not run

row_disposition_exact.why: every row carries the placeholder `active`; the frozen reader has no disposition tier (#737)

row_f1.why: rows are bounding boxes of the reader's cell text boxes, not ruled bands; a row's IoU with a labelled band is bounded by that

table_f1.why: the reader reconstructs tables with a box; matched by IoU in the gold page's declared frame

wrong_source_cited_proposals.why: no Extracted Proposal is emitted, so none can be wrong; met vacuously

note: `applies` is fixed before any run from what the frozen reader produces; a met threshold on a layer it does not produce is vacuous and says nothing about the reader
